dct_title_s: Carta prima generale d'ame rica dell' India occidentale è Mare del'Zur
dct_description_sm: Map of Mexico, Central America, Caribbean, and the top of South America. Includes many place names.
Only known copy. Smaller version of 1646 map of same title.
Title cartouche and bottom center and compass rose at bottom right.
"Il Caure [Cavalieri] AF Lucini Fecit" at bottom right.
Inset: America Maiestrale. Shows west coast of North America showing many places in California starting with C. Mendocino at the top. Includes a large gulf towards bottom labeled "Golfo Profondo".
Glen McLaughlin Map Collection of California as an Island
